name: Simple AI Compliance Pack
author: jacklw21

sections.description:
Is your chatbot illegal? As of August 2026, the EU AI Act (Article 50) requires all AI-driven interactions to clearly disclose that the user is talking to a machine.

Most chat widgets do not do this automatically. This plugin serves as your “Compliance Insurance”:

  1. The Sentinel: Automatically detects 5+ major chat widgets (Tidio, Intercom, Drift, etc).
  2. The Badge: Injects a “Automated AI System” badge next to the chat bubble.
  3. NEW: AI Scraper Blocker: Blocks OpenAI, Google, and others from training on your content.
  4. NEW: Cookie Banner: Simple, lightweight consent banner.

Short Description

Adds the legally required “AI System” transparency badge to Tidio & Intercom chatbots, ensuring compliance with EU AI Act Article 50.

Legal & Terms of Service

  1. GPL COMPLIANCE: The code is licensed under GPLv2.
  2. PROHIBITED CONDUCT: You may not systematically scrape signature definitions.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files.
  2. Go to Settings > AI Compliance.
  3. Enable the features you need.
